prompt: Estimate the number of ATMs in Delhi.

clarifications.answer: You are estimating physical ATM machines, not cards.
Count all ATMs regardless of who operates them.
Take Delhi's population as about 3 crore.

common_traps: Estimating ATM cards and forgetting to convert cards into machines via a cards-per-ATM ratio.
Using one flat cards-per-ATM ratio instead of splitting by area density.
Multiplying by population instead of households, double-counting people in the same home.

anchors.5: Chooses a household-to-cards-to-machines chain and states the cards-per-ATM assumption explicitly.
Splits by area density (or an equivalent), rather than one blanket ratio.
Carries crore/lakh conversions cleanly and lands in the 3000-6000 range.
Validates via ATM throughput, e.g. transactions per ATM per day implying each card is used at least monthly.
